description: UOS session-start policy reminder; advisory only, with no enforcement or admission claim. Migrated from the non-standard top-level key `uos_control_loop`/`PreInvocation`, which no client reads, to the `hooks.SessionStart` shape used by .codex/hooks.json and .claude/settings.json. Command payloads preserved byte-for-byte. NOT validated against a running .agents/.gemini client.

hooks.command: test -d /home/an/NAS-setup/uos/.jj && printf '%s\n' '{"injectSteps":[{"ephemeralMessage":"UOS uses standalone Jujutsu. Consult AGENTS.md for Zero-Muda, OTP and evidence requirements."}]}'

cd /home/an/NAS-setup/uos && out=$(bash tools/preflight --max-age 900 --quiet 2>&1) || out=$(bash tools/preflight --receipt --quiet 2>&1 | tail -1); printf '{"injectSteps":[{"ephemeralMessage":"UOS toolchain preflight: %s"}]}' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tr -d '\"' | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
